items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: Because years ago his great friend was Jimmy Jones... And I’ve heard him discuss that with Jimmy back in the early 60’s

ctx.x: I’ve noticed Joe seems to be spreading his wings. This new CD that’s about to be released or has just been released. Tell us about that one.

Has been — “Feel the Spirit”? That’s something Joe has, did he tell you about that? It’s something he’s wanted to do for absolutely ever since I’ve known him. Because years ago his great friend was Jimmy Jones, who was a wonderful piano player and arranger. And I’ve heard him discuss that with Jimmy back in the early 60’s that he had this in mind to, he calls it a giving thanks, a giving back for all the fun and pleasure he’s had I suppose, and he’s been dying to do it. He never could get it on, no one was…
